text:
harper: Quick question 1 part-time hire (0.6 FTE) transferred in mid-year and shows 88h PTO in Workday. Our carryover cap is 40h full-time-equivalent. How do we pro-rate and handle encashment opt-in? Need a one-off exception flow for transfers.

payroll-bot: FYI policy excerpt: 'Carryover cap is applied on an FTE-equivalent basis. When FTE < 1.0, cap = cap * FTE, rounded to nearest whole hour.' Full policy: https://hr.example/policies/pto-carryover :book: 

joel: Joel (manager): The hire transferred teams in Aug and already requested time off in Dec. If cap pro-rates below what they booked we shouldn't auto-forfeit approved time. We need manager approval to honor scheduled time, encash remainder, or move to unpaid.

aya: Aya (employee): I'm worried about losing hours. I scheduled the December week back in Oct. Happy to take the time if it fits team coverage.

harper: Proposed micro-process for transfer cases: 1) Calculate prorated cap = round(40 * FTE). For 0.6 FTE that's 24h. 2) Protect any pre-approved time that falls within the current plan window. 3) Offer employee opt-in for encashment of balance over prorated cap (deadline 2025-05-01). 4) If employee declines and manager approves the time as scheduled, honor it; else auto-encash to prorated cap.

natalie: Need the exact CSV format for payroll if we do a targeted encashment so payroll doesn't reject: suggested header: 
```
employee_id, full_name, pto_encash_hours, encash_reason, manager_approval_ts, tax_code
```
And include `pro_rated_cap_hours` as a separate column for audit (HRIS will add it).

ben: Finance note: encashment taxed per local regs. For transfers across countries, we need country tax code. Also confirm effective pay period. If we're honoring pre-approved booked time, we must block encashment for those specific dates in payroll export.

harper: Inline example calculation for clarity: 
`FT_cap = 40`
`FTE = 0.6`
`pro_rated_cap = round(FT_cap * FTE) = round(24) = 24h`
`current_balance = 88h`
`encashable = current_balance - pro_rated_cap = 64h`

joel: I'll confirm whether the Dec week is officially approved in the team calendar. If approved, we'll mark those dates as protected and reduce encashable accordingly.

natalie: I'll publish a short FAQ for transfers and a one-click opt-in link for encashment. We'll also add a manager checkbox 'protect pre-approved dates' in the form.

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll export cutoff for this one-off is 2025-05-08 and requires `encash_reason` and `manager_approval_ts` populated. See format: https://payroll.example/docs/one-off-encash-format

harper: Thanks. Action items: Natalie to draft FAQ + form, Joel to confirm approvals, Ben to confirm tax handling for cross-country transfers. We'll run the export after opt-ins close. :white_check_mark:
